AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
MyMovie provides functions for discovering movies from TMDB (The Movie Database).
Operational Patterns: - Call searchMovies with a keyword or phrase, or getTopRatedMovies, to find movies. - Pass a movie's exact title to getSimilarMovies to explore related titles.
Constraints: - Each function returns the first page of TMDB's results. - All functions require network access; results depend on TMDB API availability.
